sources.title: Transparent toy parameter and block-work accounting
sources.details: Assume embeddings/output parameters O=200000 and identical block size B=1000000 as stated. Stored parameters P=O+cB for c distinct parameter copies. Executed block work in the stated proxy is W=r when r identical blocks execute on the same input shape. Thus (c,r)=(1,1),(1,5),(5,5),(2,2) give (P,W)=(1200000,1),(1200000,5),(5200000,5),(2200000,2). P0=P1 but W0!=W1; W1=W2 but P1!=P2; fourth P and W each differ from every original row. For U common training updates with the same per-update input workload, the one-round and five-round block-forward totals are U and 5U (plus uncounted common and backward costs); equal U alone does not establish equal compute. These are assumptions/counts, not learned weights, runtime, full FLOP measurements or quality.
